issues.description: [suggestion] Weight trend line + weekly rate on the /log-weight chart. Problem: the chart plots raw daily scale weights only, and daily weight swings 0.5-1.5 kg from water/sodium/glycogen - an athlete on a cut sees a fake 1 kg overnight jump, reads it as a stall, and panic-adjusts (or quits logging); data-literate users expect the smoothed number, not the noise. Evidence: LogWeight.tsx / LogWeight.Chart render only raw daily points plus a weekly-averages toggle - no smoothed trend series, no rate-of-change anywhere in src (grep: zero hits for moving average / kg-per-week). Every serious competitor ships this (MacroFactor trend weight, Happy Scale, Withings), and our brand line is precision over encouragement - showing raw noise without the trend is the opposite. Proposed v1 (frontend-only, no backend change): (1) compute a 7-day exponentially-weighted moving average client-side from the existing daily_weight_history payload; (2) draw it as a second smooth line over the existing recharts AreaChart in daily view (raw points fade to dots); (3) one caption line under the chart: Trend 72.4 kg, -0.35 kg/week - with an on-pace/off-pace tint vs the plan target rate already known from the goal. Same chart component is reused by /weight-history-chart so both routes get it. Effort: small - one pure math helper + chart series + caption; re-run affected flow captures.

issues.description: [suggestion] Recent-meals quick log: one-tap re-log of past custom meals in the Add Custom Meal sheet on /nutrition. Problem: the custom-meal flow (CustomMealModal) is pure free-text — an athlete eating the same 4-5 meals every day must retype "200g chicken breast + 150g rice + 1 katori dal" (or re-run photo AI) on every log; there is no recents/favorites surface anywhere (verified: no recents endpoint in the backend, no history UI in src/components/nutrition/CustomMealModal.tsx). Every comparable tracker (MyFitnessPal, MacroFactor, HealthifyMe) ships Recents as the #1 logging accelerator, and our own design principle is precision tools for athletes who log multiple times daily — repeat logging is THE hot path. Evidence: meal-log history already exists server-side (free-form POST /logs/meal entries with macro estimates from photo/text analysis), so the data is sitting there unused. Proposed v1: (1) backend GET /logs/meal/recent — last N distinct free-form meals (dedupe by normalized description, keep macros); (2) a horizontal "Recent" chip row at the top of CustomMealModal — tap fills description + macros, then Log saves as usual; no favorites/pinning yet. Effort: small — one read-only endpoint + one chip-row component; no schema change, no LLM cost (reuses stored macros instead of re-analyzing).
